subject.title: fix(gateway): restore codex-cli chat history imports

question: Should maintainers rebase/adopt this Codex CLI history import now, or pause it in favor of the newer Codex app-server/session direction?
rationale: The fix addresses a real current-main gap, but it changes persisted reset/history suppression state and conflicts with newer session binding work, so automation cannot choose the durable session contract safely.

options.title: Rebase and adopt the fix
options.body: Rebase the branch onto current main, preserve current CLI binding/reseed fields, remove the release-owned changelog edit, and rerun the focused Gateway/session tests.

options.title: Pause for Codex app-server direction
options.body: Keep this PR open but wait for a maintainer decision if the newer app-server/session architecture should replace raw Codex JSONL import instead.

options.title: Close after replacement lands
options.body: Close this PR only if a merged current-main change restores Codex-backed `chat.history` with equal or better reset/upgrade proof.

recommendation.title: Rebase and adopt the fix
recommendation.body: Rebase the branch onto current main, preserve current CLI binding/reseed fields, remove the release-owned changelog edit, and rerun the focused Gateway/session tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Most directly tied to the current Claude CLI history import behavior and recent session/thread management work.
